entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-01
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Kestrel HTTP/2 performs only two of the four field validations RFC 9113 8.2.1 requires: a space or a colon in a header name, and leading or trailing whitespace in a value, are accepted #70237
  • .NET 11 regression: malformed linker XML in Components.Endpoints causes IL2101 during trimmed publishing #70236
    11.0.x
  • [Review agent] False positive: unsupported-concurrency race in AuthorizationMessageHandler on #70106 #70235
  • [Review agent] Incorrect instrument-duplication claim and ineffective test fix on #70174 #70233
  • [Review agent] False positive: MessagePack count validation ignored on #70143 #70232
  • Review Agent Failure Tracking #70231
  • ASP.NET Core's Web JSON preset keeps AllowDuplicateProperties enabled, and JsonElement has no case-insensitive lookup, so inspect-then-bind diverges #70230
  • Request Delegate Generator returns HTTP 500 instead of 400 for failed form antiforgery validation (.NET 10 and 11 RC3) #70229
  • ASP.NET Core perf effort: summary of open performance PRs #70219
  • IResponseCookies.Append: the ReadOnlySpan overload does not validate the cookie name that the other two reject #70217
  • Passkey ceremony state is stored in the two-factor cookie, so a passkey ceremony and a pending two-factor sign-in destroy each other #70207
  • MapStaticAssets: an asset file name is parsed as a route template, so braces in a name silently add a route parameter or stop the app from starting #70206
